That configured online project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier independent-review prerequisite without implying execution eligibility. There is no supplied unresolved material decision requiring an earlier decisions-stage block. Blocked readiness at assignments and both abstained-no-eligible reasons are therefore appropriate. Repository identity and base commit agree throughout, and the Gold and preview release-input fingerprints match for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. I accept the stated Service mechanical binding of digests; I did not recompute them, execute code, or infer human attestation.
